blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Existing latent world models are typically optimized for future predictability, yet the resulting representations are not necessarily useful for planning in autonomous driving. Predictions are commonly used for pretraining or auxiliary supervision rather than as direct conditioning signals for trajectory generation. We propose ForeDrive, which learns a planning-relevant latent representation and couples it asymmetrically to a Diffusion Transformer (DiT) planner. The planner consumes multi-horizon latent future representations learned with a JEPA-style world model; planning gradients update the shared online encoder, while stop-gradient routing trains the latent predictor with forecasting losses only. Because predicted futures have varying reliability across horizons and BEV trajectories are misaligned with image tokens, we use gated visual fusion, future-status injection, and Trajectory-Adaptive Bias (TAB) to inject future latents as guidance without overriding the current observation. Trained with pure imitation learning and using only the current front-view image as visual input at inference, ForeDrive attains 89.9 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 90.0 one-stage EPDMS on NAVSIM v2, without reinforcement learning or an external trajectory scorer.
blocks.zh: 现有的潜在世界模型通常被优化,以便未来的可预测性,但由此产生的表述不一定有助于自主驱动的规划。 预测通常用于预训或辅助监理,而不是作为弹道生成的直接调节信号. 我们提出ForeDrive,它学习了一种与规划相关的潜在代表,并将其不对称地与一个传播变形器(DiT)规划者结合. 规划者消耗了用JEPA风格的世界模型学到的多视距潜在未来表现;规划梯度更新了共享的在线编码器,而停止级路由则仅以预测损失来训练潜在预测器. 由于预测未来跨地平线的可靠性不同,而BEV轨迹与图像符号错配,我们使用门式视觉聚变,未来状态注入,以及Traprextory-Adaptive Bias(TAB)来注入未来潜伏物作为引导,而不压倒目前的观测. ForeDrive在NAVSIM v1上获得89.9 PDMS,在NAVSIM v2上获得90.0个一级 EMDMS,没有强化学习或外部轨迹计分器。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: End-to-end driving planners must both anticipate how a scene may evolve and generate a trajectory that covers multiple maneuvers. Latent world models ( Assran et al. 2025 ; Zhou et al. 2025 ; Karypidis et al. 2025 ; Baldassarre et al. 2025 ; Wang et al. 2026c ) predict future latent representations without RGB reconstruction, enabling efficient semantic foresight. Diffusion Transformer (DiT) planners such as DiffusionDrive ( Liao et al. 2025 ) generate multimodal trajectories under imitation learning. Forecast accuracy, however, does not guarantee planning usefulness, as predicted latents may omit decision-critical information. Conversely, current-conditioned planners generate trajectories without explicit future representations.
blocks.zh: 端到端驾驶规划者既必须预测场景会如何演变,也必须产生涵盖多种动作的轨迹. 后期世界模型(Assran et al.). 2025; 周等编. 2025; Karypidis等人著. 2025年; Baldassarre等人,2025年; Wang等人,2026年c) 预测未来没有RGB重建的潜在表述,从而能够高效的语义展望. 扩散变流器(DiT)规划者如DifupulationDrive(廖等2025年)在模仿学习下产生多模式轨迹. 但是,预测的准确性并不能保证规划的有用性,因为预测的潜在性可能会省略关键决策的信息。 相反,目前有条件的规划者产生没有明确未来表述的轨迹。

blocks.en: In existing driving systems, predicted future latent representations often provide pretraining signals, auxiliary losses, or features for candidate evaluation rather than direct conditioning signals for trajectory generation ( Li et al. 2025a ; Zheng et al. 2025 ) . Methods that do condition planning on predicted futures commonly introduce structured scene prediction, pixel-level generation, or staged optimization ( Li et al. 2025b ; Zhang et al. 2025 ; Xia et al. 2026 ) . Few methods jointly learn a latent that is useful for planning and couple it to a generative planner while preventing planning gradients from directly rewriting the predictor (Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh: 在现有驱动系统中,预测的未来潜在表示往往为候选人评价提供预训信号、辅助损失或特征,而不是为轨道生成提供直接调节信号(Li等人,2025a); 郑等 2025). 在预测的未来上进行条件规划的方法通常引入结构化场景预测,像素级生成,或者进行阶段优化(Li等人. 2025b; 张等. 2025; Xia et al. 2026 (中文(简体) ). 很少有方法共同学习一种潜在方法,对规划有用,并将其与基因规划者结合,同时防止规划梯度直接重写预测器(图1)。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Representation paradigms for end-to-end planning. (a) Reactive Planner: action generation from the current latent only (e.g., DiffusionDrive, MeanFuser). (b) Latent World Model: predicted futures mainly for pretraining or auxiliary losses (e.g., LAW, Drive-JEPA). (c) Ours: joint WM and trajectory supervision shapes the shared encoder, and futures guide the planner.

blocks.en: ForeDrive jointly learns planning-relevant latent representations and integrates multi-horizon future latents as complementary multi-scale future context into a DiT planner through asymmetric latent optimization and current-anchored fusion. Because predicted futures have varying reliability across horizons, ForeDrive treats them as complementary guidance anchored by reliable current observations, rather than allowing futures to dominate current perception. A JEPA-style online/EMA predictor estimates multi-horizon visual and ego-state latents without pixel reconstruction or a separate training stage.
blocks.zh: ForeDrive联合学习与规划相关的潜在表述,并通过不对称的潜在优化和当前定型聚变,将多视野的未来潜在作为互补的多尺度未来背景纳入DiT规划器. 由于预测的未来跨度的可靠性不同,ForeDrive将未来视为以可靠的当前观测为基础的补充指导,而不是允许未来主导当前认知. JEPA式的在线/EMA预测器估计多视距和自我状态潜伏,没有像素重建或单独的培训阶段。

blocks.en: We evaluate ForeDrive on NAVSIM under a camera-only, pure imitation-learning protocol. It attains 89.9 PDMS on v1 and 90.0 one-stage EPDMS on v2, outperforming recent end-to-end (E2E) and world-model planners under the same protocol. A zero-shot transfer to nuScenes tests cross-dataset generalization. Ablations attribute the gains mainly to future consumption, current-primary fusion, and asymmetric encoder updates.
blocks.zh: 在NAVSIM上,我们通过一个只摄像头的纯仿真学习协议评估ForeDrive。 它在v1上获得了89.9个PDMS,在v2上获得了90.0个单阶段的EPDMS,优于近期的端对端(E2E)和世界模范规划师在同一协议下的表现. 向nuScenes测试的零射转录跨数据集泛化. 膨胀将收益主要归结于未来的消耗,当前-初级聚变,以及不对称编码器更新.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose ForeDrive, which learns a planning-relevant latent representation and asymmetrically couples multi-horizon latent prediction with trajectory generation. Planning updates the shared encoder while stop-gradient routing prevents planning gradients from updating the latent predictor, reducing prediction–planning gradient interference. • We introduce planning-oriented interfaces, including gated visual fusion, future-status injection, and Trajectory-Adaptive Bias (TAB), that incorporate predicted future dynamics into diffusion planning. These designs keep the current observation as primary evidence, and TAB links each trajectory candidate to the image tokens along its projected path during denoising. • We validate ForeDrive on NAVSIM v1 and v2 under a camera-only, pure imitation-learning protocol (89.9 PDMS / 90.0 EPDMS). Using only a single front-view image at inference, ForeDrive establishes a new state-of-the-art among imitation-learning methods.

blocks.en: End-to-End Autonomous Driving. End-to-end driving maps sensor observations directly to planned trajectories. Early systems such as TransFuser and UniAD emphasize multi-sensor fusion and BEV-centric perception–planning ( Chitta et al. 2023 ; Hu et al. 2023 ; Li et al. 2022 ) , while recent work increasingly adopts camera-only inputs ( Liao et al. 2025 ; Wang et al. 2026a ; Wozniak et al. 2026 ) . Beyond imitation learning, several high-scoring methods further apply reinforcement-learning post-training, as in ReCogDrive-RL ( Li et al. 2026b ) , or rule-based candidate scoring, as in Hydra-MDP and DriveSuprim ( Li et al. 2024 ; Yao et al. 2026 ) . These stages raise benchmark scores, but the gains of a pure imitation-learning planner without RL or external scorers remain less clear. ForeDrive therefore adopts a camera-only, pure-IL setting and examines whether a planning-relevant foresight representation improves the sensor-to-plan model without RL post-training or auxiliary scorers.
blocks.zh: 端对端自主驾驶. 端对端驱动地图传感器观测直接到计划轨迹. TransFuser和UniAD等早期系统强调多传感器聚变和以BEV为中心的感知-规划(Chitta et al. 2023; Hu et al. 2023; Li et al. 2022)),而最近的工作越来越多地采用只摄像头输入(Liao et al. 2025; Wang et al. 2026a; Wozniak et al. 2026 ). 除了模仿学习外,几种高分法还进一步应用了强化学习后培训方法,如ReCogDrive-RL(Li et al. 2026b),或基于规则的候选人评分,如Hydra-MDP和DriveSuprim(Li et al. 2024; 姚等 2026 (中文(简体) ). 这些阶段提高了基准分数,但是没有RL或外部计分员的纯模仿-学习计划者的收益仍然不太明确. 前导 因此,驱动器采用只摄像头、纯IL设定,并审查与规划有关的展望表现是否改进了传感器到计划模型,而无需经过RL培训或辅助计分。

blocks.en: Diffusion-based Planning. Diffusion models are widely used for multimodal trajectory generation in end-to-end driving, as iterative denoising can represent multiple futures and trajectory uncertainty under imitation learning. DiffusionDrive combines truncated diffusion with trajectory anchors; DiffRefiner ( Yin et al. 2026 ) , MeanFuser, and GoalFlow ( Xing et al. 2025 ) further develop coarse-to-fine, one-step, and flow-matching variants. These planners are typically conditioned on current or short-history features and do not condition on an explicit predicted future for planning. ForeDrive retains anchor-based diffusion decoding and feeds multi-horizon latent predictions as complementary guidance under asymmetric coupling.
blocks.zh: 传播计划。 扩散模型在端到端驱动中被广泛用于多模式的轨迹生成,因为迭代去诺可以代表模仿学习下的多种未来和轨迹不确定性. 扩散Drive将短径扩散与轨迹锚结合;DiffRefinner(Yin等人,2026年),MeanFuser,和GoalFlow(Xing等人,2025年)进一步发展粗细对细,单步,流量匹配的变体. 这些规划者通常以当前或短历史特征为条件,并不以明确的预测未来为规划条件。 ForeDrive保留了基于锚的传播解码,并为多视距潜在预测提供素材,作为不对称耦合下的补充指导.

blocks.en: World Models for Driving. Prior work couples foresight and driving in four ways. (i) Predictive world models with structured scene forecasting use BEV or occupancy futures for planning ( Hu et al. 2021 ; Wang et al. 2024 ; Zheng et al. 2024 ; Chen et al. 2025 ; Li et al. 2025b ; Zheng et al. 2025 ) . (ii) JEPA-style latent predictors such as Drive-JEPA and LAW ( Wang et al. 2026c ; Li et al. 2025a ) mainly treat predicted latents as pretraining or auxiliary signals rather than as inputs to a generative planner. (iii) Video-prediction approaches such as Epona and DriveLaW ( Zhang et al. 2025 ; Xia et al. 2026 ) condition trajectory DiTs on generated video features, but rely on pixel generation and, for DriveLaW, multi-stage freezing. (iv) Unconstrained planning-conditioned prediction allows planning objectives to reshape the foresight module without isolating forecast supervision ( Wang et al. 2026b ; Li et al. 2026a ; Zhao et al. 2025 ) . ForeDrive instead learns planning-relevant latents and couples them to a generative planner under asymmetric optimization, keeping current evidence primary.
blocks.zh: 世界驾驶模式。 工作前的夫妇有四个方面 (一)具有结构化场景预报功能的预测世界模型使用BEV或占用期货进行规划(Hu et al. 2021; 王等编. 2024; 郑等. 2024; 陈等. 2025; 李等人著. 2025b;Zheng等人,2025年).(二)JEPA风格的潜在预测器,如Drive-JEPA和LAW(Wang等人,2026c;Li等人,2025a)主要将预测的潜伏器视为预训或辅助信号,而不是对基因规划器的投入. (三)Epona和DriveLaW等视频预测方法(张等. 2025; Xia等人 2026) 条件轨迹 DiTs在生成的视频功能上,但依赖像素生成,对DriveLaW来说,是多阶段的冻结. (四)无限制的规划条件预测使得规划目标能够在不孤立预测监督的情况下重塑展望模块(Wang等人. 2026b; Li等人 2026a; Zhao等人 2025). 前导 相反,推动学习与规划相关的潜质,并将它们与基因规划者结合,进行不对称优化,保持现有证据的首要性。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: In this section, we present ForeDrive (Figure 3 ). We define a planning-relevant latent as a future representation that is grounded by predictive supervision while retaining information useful for downstream trajectory generation. These objectives introduce a trade-off because forecasting favors target alignment, while planning benefits from decision-sensitive information. ForeDrive mitigates this trade-off by learning such latents with a JEPA-style world model, injecting them into a DiT planner as complementary guidance through planning-oriented interfaces (gated fusion, future-status injection, and TAB), and applying asymmetric latent optimization. Implementation details, architectural configurations, and hyperparameters are provided in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍ForeDrive(图3)。 我们把与规划相关的潜在表述定义为一种未来表述,这种表述的基础是预测性监督,同时保留对下游轨道生成有用的信息。 这些目标带来了一种权衡,因为预测有利于目标一致,而规划则得益于对决策敏感的信息。 前导 通过学习JEPA式的世界模式的潜在作用,通过规划导向的界面(聚变、未来状态注射和TAB),以及应用不对称的潜在优化,将它们注入DiT规划器作为补充指导,从而缓解这种权衡。 补充材料中提供了实施细节、建筑配置和超参数。

blocks.en: Planning-Relevant Latent World Model
blocks.zh: 规划 - 相关后期世界模式

blocks.en: Planning depends on future agent motion, ego-state evolution, and other scene changes that need not be represented at pixel level. This module therefore predicts future latent representations at multiple temporal scales for planning. We adopt a JEPA-style online/EMA architecture to predict latents in a DINOv3-initialized space ( Oquab et al. 2024 ; Siméoni et al. 2025 ) . The online encoder is shared with the planner, while the predictor is optimized only by the forecasting losses defined below. This separation allows planning to shape the source representation without directly updating the predictor with planning gradients.
blocks.zh: 规划取决于未来的代理运动,自我状态进化,以及不需要以像素水平表示的其他场景变化. 因此,本单元预测了今后在多个时间范围内进行规划的潜在表述。 我们采用了JEPA式的在线/EMA架构,以预测DINOv3初始空间中的潜在作用(Oquab等人)。 2024; Siméoni 等人著. 2025). 在线编码器与规划者共享,而预测器仅通过下面定义的预测损失来优化. 这种分离使得规划可以塑造源表示,而不直接用规划梯度更新预测器.

blocks.en: Anchor-based DiT decoding represents trajectory candidates in ego/BEV coordinates, while the visual stream consists of front-view image tokens. Standard trajectory-to-visual cross-attention therefore lacks an explicit correspondence between BEV paths and image patches. We introduce Trajectory-Adaptive Bias (TAB) as a trajectory-aware visual attention interface to connect BEV trajectory candidates with front-view image tokens. For each mode, TAB projects the current ego/BEV trajectory candidate onto the front-camera image and builds a soft Gaussian proximity field over visual tokens; its log affinity is added to the cross-attention logits, so each mode attends more strongly to visual tokens near its projected path while retaining access to the full scene.
blocks.zh: 基于Anchor的DiT解码代表自负/BEV坐标中的轨迹候选人,而视觉流则由前视图像符号组成. 因此,标准轨迹对视觉的交叉注意缺乏BEV路径和图像补丁之间的明确对应。 我们引入了Traphory-Adaptive Bias(TAB)作为具有轨迹意识的视觉关注界面,将BEV轨迹候选人与前视图像符号连接起来. 对于每种模式,TAB将当前自负/BEV轨迹候选人投射到前摄像头图像上,并在视觉标志上构建一个柔软的高斯近距离场;其日志亲和性被添加到交叉意向日志中,因此每个模式在保留访问完整场景的同时更强烈地关注其预定路径附近的视觉标志.

blocks.en: As denoising updates the trajectory candidates, TAB recomputes the bias at stage boundaries. The bias is mode-specific and differentiable; if a candidate has no valid projection, the added bias is constant and leaves the attention distribution unchanged. We apply TAB in every decoder layer of both stages, independently of future injection.
blocks.zh: 随着去诺更新轨迹考生,TAB在阶段边界重算偏差. 偏差是模式特有的,可以有区别的;如果一个候选人没有有效的投影,所增加的偏差是不变的,注意力分布不变. 我们在两个阶段的每一个解码层都施用TAB,独立于未来注射.

blocks.en: Asymmetric Latent Optimization
blocks.zh: 非对称缓冲优化

blocks.en: The online representation z 0 z_{0} is shared by forecasting and planning, so the two objectives may introduce optimization interference. Back-propagating the planning loss through the predictor can turn P ψ P_{\psi} into a planning feature adapter and weaken forecast fidelity, whereas freezing the encoder for forecasting prevents planning from shaping actionable futures. ForeDrive mitigates this interference with asymmetric latent optimization via stop-gradient routing: both losses update the shared encoder, but planning gradients do not update the latent predictor.

Retraining the default recipe from three different random seeds yields PDMS in 89.7–89.9 with a standard deviation of 0.1; the table reports the primary run. Scaling only the vision encoder to ViT-L/16 further reaches 90.4 PDMS. Under the pure-IL protocol, these gains hold across seeds.

blocks.en: The first two settings best match EMA visual targets (lowest ℒ lat \mathcal{L}_{\rm lat} 5.93 / 6.07; highest latent cosine 0.843 / 0.838) yet obtain the weakest PDMS (87.9 / 88.6). Encoder-updating joint training raises PDMS to 89.6–89.9 despite weaker visual alignment. Under matched future injection, full joint improves over encoder detachment by 1.3 PDMS; with encoder updates retained, enabling injection adds 0.3 over the auxiliary-only joint baseline. Across variants, better generic latent forecast alignment does not necessarily correspond to higher planning scores, indicating that planning-oriented representations may deviate from prediction-optimal targets to preserve decision-relevant information.
blocks.zh: 前两个设置最符合EMA的视觉目标(最低的L lat { mathcal{L}_{\rm lat}5.93 / 6.07;最高的潜在余弦0.843 / 0.838),但获得最弱的PDMS(87.9 / 88.6). 编码器更新联合训练将PDMS提升到89.6-89.9,尽管视觉对齐能力较弱. 在匹配的未来注射中,1.3 PDMS对编码器分解进行了全面的联合改进;保留了编码器的更新,使得注射比辅助性联合基线增加了0.3。 在各种变式中,更好的通用潜在预测调整不一定对应较高的规划分数,表明以规划为导向的表述可能偏离预测-最佳目标,以保存与决策有关的信息。

blocks.en: Under a matched protocol with TAB and future-status ego-KV disabled, we compare future-injection interfaces in Table 7 . Gated current-primary fusion attains 89.4 PDMS; current-only is lower by 0.5, while future-only drops by 5.2. Predicted futures therefore improve planning only when fused with the present observation, and current evidence should remain primary. Concatenation, dual-memory, and ungated fusion trail gated fusion by 0.2–0.4, indicating that a gated residual interface is preferable to exposing additional future tokens alone. Under the same TAB-/status-off protocol, permuting predicted horizons at inference leaves PDMS unchanged at 89.4 89.4 , whereas zeroing futures at test time reduces it to 88.0 88.0 . The permutation result suggests that the planner mainly exploits aggregated multi-scale future context rather than strict horizon ordering, which is consistent with our parallel latent prediction design. Full breakdowns are reported in the supplementary material.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: ForeDrive learns planning-relevant future latent representations and couples them asymmetrically to a DiT planner. Asymmetric latent optimization via stop-gradient routing mitigates direct prediction–planning optimization interference, while planning-oriented interfaces that include gated fusion, future-status injection, and TAB connect predicted futures to diffusion planning. With a single front-view image at inference and pure imitation learning, ForeDrive attains 89.9 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 90.0 EPDMS on v2. Matched ablations show that auxiliary forecasting alone is insufficient, that incorporating future latents is necessary, and that encoder updates yield planning-relevant futures despite weaker EMA alignment.
blocks.zh: ForeDrive学习了与规划相关的未来潜在表述,并将它们不对称地与DiT规划师对齐. 通过停止级路由实现不对称的潜在优化可以缓解直接预测 — — 规划优化干预,而规划导向的界面包括门式聚变、未来状态注入和TAB将预测的未来与扩散规划联系起来。 ForeDrive在推论和纯仿真学习上以单一的前视图像获得89.9 PDMS在NAVSIM v1和90.0 EMDMS在v2上. 匹配的模拟显示,单靠辅助预测是不够的,必须纳入未来潜伏因素,而且尽管EMA调整能力较弱,编码器仍更新了与规划有关的期货。

blocks.en: The evaluation is limited to camera-only, non-reactive simulation, where inaccurate futures can still mislead the planner. Testing under interactive closed-loop settings is an important next step.
blocks.zh: 评估仅限于只摄像头,非反应模拟,其中不准确的期货仍然可以误导规划者. 在交互式闭路设置下进行测试是下一步的一个重要步骤。

blocks.en:
The default backbone is DINOv3 ViT-B/16.
It encodes the current front image into 512 patch tokens of width 768.
An EMA copy of the vision encoder provides stop-gradient targets for future frames; only this encoder is mirrored.
A lightweight Transformer predictor forecasts multi-horizon (multi-scale) visual latents and ego-status quantities from current tokens and learnable future queries.
blocks.zh:
默认主干是DINov3 VIT-B/16.
它将当前前身图像编码为宽度768的512个补丁符号.
视觉编码器的EMA副本为未来的帧提供了停止升级目标;只有这个编码器被镜像.
一个轻量级的变形器预测器从当前符号和可学习的未来查询中预测多视野(多尺度)视觉潜伏和自我状态的数量。

blocks.en:
The predictor is a 4-layer pre-LN Transformer of width 512 (8 heads, FFN 2048, GELU, dropout 0.1).
Linear projections bridge the 768-D encoder space and the predictor width; time/token embeddings and future queries share that width.
Attention uses a frame-level block-causal mask: tokens within a horizon attend freely, while later horizons stay invisible.
All horizons are predicted in one forward pass, not by autoregressive rollout.
Each horizon emits a status token for a 4-way navigation-command classifier (CE) and raw velocity/acceleration regressions (MSE).
Predicted visual futures are projected back to 768-D before the latent loss.
blocks.zh:
预测器是宽度512(8头,FFN 2048,GELU,退出0.1)的4层前LN变形器.
线性预测连接768-D编码器空间和预测器宽度;时间/托肯嵌入和未来的查询共享该宽度.
注意使用帧级的块-因果面具:一个视野内的信使自由出席,而后来的视野则保持隐形.
所有地平线都通过一个前进通道来预测,而不是通过自动推出来预测.
每个地平线为4路导航指令分类器(CE)和原始速度/加速回归(MSE)发出状态符.
预测的视觉未来在潜在损失前被预测回768-D.

blocks.en:
Foresight supervision covers the four default horizons.
Visual terms use token-averaged L 1 L_{1} against EMA targets, without a patch mask.
Horizon weights are proportional to 1 / ( i + 1 ) 1/(i{+}1) on the 2 Hz index i i , then rescaled to unit mean.
The status objective equally weights command CE and motion MSE, and is scaled by 0.1 0.1 in the joint loss.

blocks.en:
Predicted futures condition the planner without replacing current evidence.
Current and future visual tokens are projected to width 256 (Linear+LayerNorm), then given shared spatial embeddings and learnable per-horizon time embeddings.
A sample-shared sigmoid gate scales each future stream before fusion; it encodes dataset-level horizon preference, not per-sample reliability.
Fusion is one Post-LN cross-attention layer (8 heads, no FFN): current tokens are residual queries, and gated futures are keys/values.
blocks.zh:
预言的期货给计划者带来条件,而不取代目前的证据.
目前和未来视觉符号预计宽度为256(Linear+LayerNorm),然后给予共享空间嵌入和可学习的每视距时间嵌入.
一个样品共享的sigmoid门在聚变前对每个未来流进行比例;它编码数据集水平的偏好,而不是每个样本的可靠性.
Fusion是一款LN后跨层(8个头,没有FFN):现在的符号是剩余查询,门头期货是键/值.

blocks.en:
Complementary predicted future ego motion is injected as planner memory (not ground-truth future status).
Stop-gradient predicted velocity and acceleration are embedded to width 256, scaled by a second sample-shared sigmoid gate, and concatenated with the measured current ego embedding.
Navigation commands are not routed through this path.
The resulting ego memory conditions every decoder layer with the fused visual tokens.
blocks.zh:
作为规划者记忆(而不是地面真实的未来地位)注入了对未来自我运动的补充预测。
停止梯度预测速度和加速度被嵌入到宽度256,由第二个样品共享的西格莫德门缩放,并与测量到的自负嵌入配合.
导航命令不通过此路径 。
由此产生的自我记忆条件 每一个解码层 与引信的视觉标志。

blocks.en:
TAB is a soft geometry prior that links BEV trajectory candidates to front-view image tokens.
It provides a trajectory-conditioned spatial bias rather than learned sample-specific attention weights.
Each candidate pose is projected into the camera.
A pose is valid only if camera depth exceeds 10 − 3 10^{-3} and the pixel lies inside the image (no clamping); invalid poses are excluded.
For each mode–token pair, we take the maximum Gaussian affinity (bandwidth 0.25 0.25 ) between the token center and the mode’s valid projected waypoints, then convert it to a log-bias with floor 10 − 6 10^{-6} .
If a mode has no valid projection, the bias is a uniform shift and leaves the softmax unchanged.
blocks.zh:
TAB是将BEV轨迹候选物与前视图像符号链接的软几何前身.
它提供了轨迹条件的空间偏差,而不是所学得的特定样本的注意权重。
每个候选人的姿势都被投射到镜头中.
一个姿势只有在相机深度超过10−3 10^{-3}且像素位于图像内部(没有夹子)时才有效;无效姿势被排除.
对于每个模式 — token 配对, 我们取代号中心与模式的有效预测路标之间的最大高斯亲和度( 带宽 0. 25 0. 25 ), 然后转换为log-bias, 底座为 10 - 6 10 - 6 } 。
如果一个模式没有有效的投影,则偏差是统一的转动,而软磁轴不变.

blocks.en:
We add this bias to trajectory-to-visual attention logits before softmax in every layer of both DiT stages, broadcast across heads.
Ego-memory cross-attention is unchanged.
Within one DDIM step, the first stage shares the initial noisy-anchor plan for projection; later layers then use that stage’s supervised plan.
blocks.zh:
我们把这种偏差加到轨迹到视觉的注意记录中, 在两个DiT阶段的每一个层的软放大之前, 横跨头部广播。
爱果摩尼交叉意念不动.
在DDIM的一步中,第一阶段共享最初的噪音-锚定器投影计划;随后各层使用该阶段的监督计划。

blocks.en:
Following DiffusionDrive, we use truncated diffusion over 20 fixed k k -means ( x , y ) (x,y) anchors; heading is tanh ⁡ ( ⋅ ) ⋅ π \tanh(\cdot)\cdot\pi .
Training uses a 1,000-step DDIM schedule with sample prediction and truncated noise levels from { 0 , … , 49 } \{0,\ldots,49\} .

blocks.en:
We intervene on a checkpoint trained without TAB and without predicted future-status injection (gated fusion only; Table 2 ).
Degradations must then come from the visual future channel. Normal leads among predicted-future settings: fusion sees in-distribution WM tokens. Oracle gains only + 0.2 +0.2 : GT futures are cleaner but still mismatched to the predictor-trained fusion path. Horizon shuffle matches normal on every subscore ( 89.4 89.4 ).
With the main-paper permutation result, this suggests the DiT uses multi-horizon futures as aggregated multi-scale temporal context rather than a strict ordered rollout; over-smoothed predictions further weaken the order probe. Token mask ( − 0.4 -0.4 ) is mild: remaining in-distribution tokens still help.
The key contrast is zero versus identity corruptions.
Zeroing drops PDMS by 1.4 1.4 , mainly via EP/DAC (EP 83.6 → 81.2 83.6{\to}81.2 , DAC 97.1 → 95.8 97.1{\to}95.8 ), while TTC/NC slightly improve.
Without futures the policy is more conservative but less progressive—bad for PDMS, not mainly via collisions. Persistence and cross-sample fall below zero ( 87.0 87.0 vs. 88.0 88.0 ): gated fusion can down-weight near-empty inputs, yet still trusts structured but semantically wrong futures; TTC collapses ( 93.7 93.7 / 93.2 93.2 ) despite higher EP than zero.
Summary: matched predictions help; GT helps little under mismatch; missing futures hurt progress; wrong futures hurt collision metrics more than no futures.
A remaining limitation is that predicted latents are over-smoothed relative to GT.

blocks.en: Appendix I Trajectory Probe of Future Latents
blocks.zh: 附录一 未来梯队的轨迹探测

blocks.en:
Detach improves PDMS while final WM reconstruction stays nearly unchanged.
Do predicted latents preserve more trajectory-relevant information, or are they only equally reconstructible?
Closed-loop scores and WM L 1 L_{1} /cosine cannot separate those cases.
We freeze the vision encoder and world model and train a weak readout to regress expert trajectories from one latent source at a time.
Unlike reconstruction probes, this tests whether latents retain information useful for trajectory regression; it does not prove that the planner must rely on these latents, nor that the representation is planning-optimal.
It complements Sec. D : swapping EMA-GT into a predictor-trained planner yields little PDMS gain (mismatch); a freshly trained shallow head can still ask which frozen latent is more trajectory-readable.
blocks.zh:
分解改进了PDMS,而最终WM重建则几乎保持不变.
预测的潜伏物是否保存了更多与轨迹有关的信息,或者它们是否同样可以重建?
闭路分数和WM L 1 L_{1}/Cosine不能将这些案件分开。
我们冻结了视觉编码器和世界模型,并训练一个弱读器,使专家的轨迹一次从一个潜在来源倒退。
与重建探测器不同的是,这种测试是,潜伏物是否保留了对轨迹回归有用的信息;它没有证明规划者必须依赖这些潜伏物,也没有证明其表现方式是规划-优化的。
它补充了Sec.D:将EMA-GT换成一个经过预测器训练的规划者,产生的PDMS收益很小(密歇根);新训练的浅头仍然可以问到哪个被冷冻的潜伏更能读出轨迹。

blocks.en:
Scenes and readout architecture are fixed; only the latent source changes.
Each condition trains its own two-layer MLP.
Per-horizon latents are spatially mean-pooled and concatenated in time; the backbone stays frozen.
We use about 20k/4k train/val scenes, train 50 epochs, and report best ADE.
As a diagnostic, we permute future horizons at evaluation: a large ADE rise means the readout uses cross-horizon structure.
Sources: (i) current-frame features; (ii) ForeDrive predicted futures; (iii) prediction-optimized predicted futures (better WM reconstruction, weaker PDMS in the main paper); (iv) EMA target futures.
blocks.zh:
场景和读出架构是固定的;只有潜在的源变化.
每个条件都训练自己的两层MLP.
半视距潜伏物在空间上是平均集合的,在时间上是凝固的;骨干保持冷冻.
我们使用大约20k/4k列车/val场景,50个世纪列车,并报告最好的ADE.
作为诊断,我们在评价时将未来的视野固定下来:一个大的ADE上升表示读取使用跨视距结构.
资料来源: (一)当前框架特征; (二)ForeDrive预测未来; (三)预测-优化预测未来(WM重建更好,主论文PDMS较弱); (四)EMA目标期货.

blocks.en:
ForeDrive yields the lowest readout error (ADE 1.55 1.55 vs. 1.83 1.83 / 2.10 2.10 / 2.31 2.31 ; Table 9 ).
Current is worst, so gains are not current-only leakage.
ForeDrive beats the prediction-optimized future by about 0.28 0.28 ADE ( ≈ 15 % {\approx}15\% ).
The latter matches EMA targets more closely yet scores lower PDMS: better reconstruction need not mean a more actionable future.
ForeDrive also beats EMA-GT under this shallow probe, consistent with planning-joint training favoring trajectory-readable futures over scene-target fidelity.
Horizon shuffle raises ADE by about 0.8 0.8 – 1.5 1.5 for all future sources, so latents retain cross-horizon structure.
This contrasts with the planner’s near-invariance to shuffle (Sec. D ): the DiT aggregates multi-scale context robustly, while the latent still preserves temporal structure for an ordered readout.

前驱产量 (ADE 1.55 1.55 vs 1.83 1.83 2.10 2.31 2.31;表9)
目前情况最糟,因此收益不是目前唯一的渗漏。
ForeDrive以约0.28 0.28 ADE(≈ 15% {\ } 15\% \%)击败了预测-优化的未来.
后者更贴近EMA目标,但得分较低PDMS:更好的重建并不意味着一个更可操作的未来。
ForeDrive也在这个浅薄的探测器下击败EMA-GT,与计划-联合训练一致,偏好轨迹可读的未来而不是场景-目标忠诚.
Horizon Shuffle将ADE提升约0.8 0.8 — 1.5 个未来所有源,因此潜伏物保留了跨视距结构.
这与规划者对洗牌(Sec. D)的近乎不常态形成对比:DiT 强力地聚合了多尺度上下文,而潜伏性仍然保留了订购读取的时间结构.

blocks.en:
In short, under a frozen backbone and shallow readout, ForeDrive predicted futures regress expert plans more accurately than a more reconstruction-accurate predicted future, EMA targets, and current-only features.
This provides evidence that predicted latents preserve trajectory-relevant information, rather than serving only as ordinary future-feature augmentation; we do not claim a planning-optimal representation.
blocks.zh:
简言之,在冰冻的骨干和浅析的读取下,ForeDrive预测的期货会比更精确的重建准确的预测未来,EMA目标,以及目前唯一的特征,更准确地倒退专家计划.
这提供了证据,表明预测的潜在物能保存与轨迹有关的信息,而不是仅仅作为普通的未来特质增强;我们并不声称有规划的最佳代表性。

blocks.en: Appendix J Latent RGB Probe Visualization
blocks.zh: 附录J Lententnt RGB 探测可视化

blocks.en:
The trajectory probe tests planning readability; we also check scene grounding.
We train a lightweight RGB readout on a frozen ForeDrive encoder, without updating the world model or planner.
blocks.zh:
轨迹探测器计划可读性,我们也检查现场。
我们在一个冷冻的ForeDrive编码器上训练一个轻量级的RGB读数,而不更新世界模型或规划器.

blocks.en:
The readout is a lightweight upsampling decoder from frozen DINOv3 ViT-B patch tokens to 256 × 512 256\times 512 RGB, trained with weighted L1 + LPIPS.
The same decoder is shared across current and future frames.
blocks.zh:
读出器是一种轻量级的升标解码器,从冷冻的DINOv3 Vit-B补丁符号到256×512 256\times 512 RGB,经过加权L1+LPIPS的训练.
同一解码器在目前和未来框架之间共享。

blocks.en:
We freeze the jointly trained online/EMA vision encoder and fit only the probe on up to 20k cached training scenes.
Inputs are frozen encodings of the current frame and WM future frames (about 0.5 0.5 – 4 ​ s 4\,\mathrm{s} ); targets are camera RGB.
We optimize ℒ = 1.0 ⋅ L1 + 0.1 ⋅ LPIPS \mathcal{L}=1.0\cdot\mathrm{L1}+0.1\cdot\mathrm{LPIPS} (AlexNet) with AdamW (lr 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} , wd 10 − 4 10^{-4} , batch 16) for 8 epochs.
Training uses EMA latents only—not predictor rollouts—so the probe tests whether the latent space itself is RGB-decodable (final train loss ≈ 0.069 \approx 0.069 ).
At visualization time we decode both EMA targets and predictor rollouts with the same frozen probe.
Predicted latents lie in the same space via the latent prediction objective, so qualitative comparison needs no predictor update.
blocks.zh:
我们冻结了联合训练的在线/EMA视觉编码器,并且只适合探测器在多达20千个缓存的训练场景上.
输入是当前帧和WM未来帧的冻结编码(约0.5 – 4 s 4\,\mathrm{s});目标为相机RGB.
我们优化 L = 1.0 + L1 + 0.1 + LPIPS + mathcal{L}=1.0\cdot\mathrm{L1}+0.1\cdot\mathrm{LPIPS} (AlexNet) 与 AdamW (lr 3× 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4}, wd 10− 4 10^{-4}, 第 16批) 共 8个时代.
培训只使用EMA潜伏装置——而不是预测器的推出——所以探测器测试潜伏空间本身是否为RGB-可解码(最后的列车损失 ~ 0.069\ 约 0.069)。
在可视化时间,我们解码EMA目标 和预测器的推出 同一冷冻探测器。
通过潜在的预测目标,预测的潜在存在在同一空间,因此质量比较不需要预测器更新。

blocks.en:
Figure 4 shows four NAVSIM scenes.
Reconstructions are intentionally coarse, as expected for a latent prediction space not trained for photorealism.
Still, the probe recovers scene structure useful for planning diagnostics—road layout (c), nearby vehicles and buildings (a,d), and ego-motion-consistent viewpoint change (b)—with coherent evolution from t = 1 t{=}1 to t = 4 t{=}4 .
Predicted futures remain scene-grounded after asymmetric joint training; the RGB readout is diagnostic only and never used for planning.
blocks.zh:
图4显示了四个NAVSIM场景.
重建是故意粗糙的,对潜在预测空间的预期是没有经过光现实主义训练的。
尽管如此,探测器还是恢复了可用于规划诊断的场景结构——道路布局(c),附近的车辆和建筑物(a,d),以及自我-运动-一致的观点变化(b)——从t=1 t{=}1到t=4 t{=}4的连贯演变.
预言期货在不对称联合训练后仍以场景为根据;RGB读出仅具有诊断性,从未用于规划.
